name: usturlab
description: Add all your AI subscriptions (multiple Claude accounts, Codex, Gemini, Copilot) and route every task to the best account and model with user-defined rules and automatic quota failover.

commands.title: usturlab: Sync MCP Servers to All Profiles

usturlab.permissionMode.markdownDescription: How much autonomy routed CLIs get: `safe` (read/plan only), `edits` (auto-accept file edits), `full` (skip all approvals — use with care).

usturlab.pollUsage.markdownDescription: Proactively poll provider usage endpoints (Claude 5h/weekly window, Copilot AI credits) to show quota in the Accounts view. Uses undocumented endpoints; off by default.

usturlab.cliPath.claude.description: Path to the claude CLI binary.

usturlab.cliPath.codex.description: Path to the codex CLI binary.

usturlab.cliPath.gemini.description: Path to the gemini CLI binary.

usturlab.cliPath.copilot.description: Path to the copilot CLI binary.

usturlab.notifyOnFinish.description: Show a notification when a chat task finishes while its tab is not focused.

usturlab.midRunStrategy.markdownDescription: What happens when you send a message while a task runs on a provider without live input (Codex/Gemini/Copilot). Claude always receives it live. `queue`: runs right after the current task. `restart`: cancels the in-flight task and re-asks with both messages merged — feels immediate, but discards unfinished tool work.

usturlab.routingMode.markdownDescription: `auto`: usturlab reads the task, judges its difficulty and picks the model — keeping nearly-exhausted accounts in reserve. `manual`: follow your rules and default chain exactly. Your rules always win in both modes.

usturlab.autoPlanHeavyEdits.markdownDescription: In auto mode, plan heavy code-writing work before it edits: usturlab switches that turn to Plan so you can review the approach. Turn off to let heavy work edit straight away.

usturlab.sendWorkspaceContext.markdownDescription: Tell the model what it would have known sitting where you are: the open file and your selection, the branch and uncommitted changes, and the project's own convention files. Whatever a CLI already reads by itself is not sent twice.

usturlab.frameTasks.markdownDescription: Add the framing a request is missing before it runs: the exact check the model should run when it is done, reproducing a bug before fixing it, naming files before editing them, and staying inside the scope you asked for. Only ever adds what your prompt did not already cover, never rewrites it. Requires `#usturlab.sendWorkspaceContext#`.

usturlab.standingInstructions.markdownDescription: Give each provider the standing instructions it needs to behave like the best one — delivered through its own system-prompt channel. Lines that measurably lower the clean-run rate are dropped automatically.

usturlab.verifyChanges.markdownDescription: After a run changes files, run the project's **own** typecheck/test script and, if it fails, give the model one chance to fix it. Commands are never invented — only what `package.json` or a `Makefile` declares. Never runs in Plan mode.

usturlab.secondOpinion.markdownDescription: Have a **different** provider review the work before you rely on it — a different model sees different mistakes. `hard`: only on work classified as hard. Connect an **OpenRouter** account and the review runs on a free open-weight model, costing none of your quota; without one it spends a second subscription and is skipped when headroom is low.

usturlab.askPermission.markdownDescription: Stop and ask before consequential actions — running a command, changing a file — instead of deciding from the permission mode alone. Works on **every** provider: Codex and the ACP agents ask over their own protocols, and Claude asks through a local MCP bridge (it cannot ask over stream-json). Reads are never interrupted, and Plan mode still refuses rather than asking.
